lead: The conditions of a list as chips on one line: a chip says what it filters ("Status is Paid") and opens a popover to change it, "Filter" adds a condition. In the popover there are rows of conditions and groups of them (all of / any of, nested as deep as needed). It edits the `filter` of a list request: a condition `{ field, op, value }` or a group `{ logic, items }`. Put it with a [SearchInput](/search-input) above a [DataTable](/data-table).

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: `fields` say what can be filtered. A field is `text`, `number`, `date`, `enum` (with `options`) or `boolean`, and each type has its operators (contains, is, between, is one of…); `ops` on a field replaces them. What is typed is shown below as the filter you would send to the API.

preset.title: A filter in use
preset.description: A group stays one chip, in brackets: opening it edits the group. Two chips or more have the logic joining them (all of / any of) on the left.

capabilities.title: What the backend can do
capabilities.description: `capabilities` takes the options away that the backend cannot express: `or: false` leaves out "any of", `nested: false` the groups inside groups, and `uniqueFields` lets a field be in the filter once.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: The chips, the popover's editor and its rows are slots (`query-builder`, `query-builder-chip`, `query-builder-editor`, `query-builder-group`, `query-builder-group-head`, `query-builder-lead`, `query-builder-row`, `query-builder-value`, `query-builder-empty`), styled by `query-builder.css`; a nested group has `data-nested`.
